    AI Overview
    Sean Miller is the head coach of the Texas Longhorns men's basketball team, named the 27th head coach in program history on March 24, 2025. He is a veteran coach with over 20 years of experience, previously leading Xavier and Arizona, and brought a proven track record of NCAA Tournament success to Austin, as of 2026. 
    This video features an interview with Coach Sean Miller discussing his plans for the team:
    36:34
    On Texas Football
    YouTube• Oct 2, 2025
    Key Details About Sean Miller: 
    • Experience: Before Texas, Miller spent time at Xavier University (2004–2009, 2022–2025) and the University of Arizona (2009–2021)
      .
    • Record: He has a high winning percentage, with over 480 wins in his collegiate coaching career.
    • Tournament Success: He has led teams to multiple Sweet 16 and Elite Eight appearances.
    • 2025-26 Season: As of March 2026, he is leading the Longhorns in the NCAA Tournament, focusing on strengthening the team's defense. 
    Other Texas Basketball Personnel: 
    • General Manager: Chris Ogden
    • Assistant Coaches: Ryan Anderson, Adam Cohen
    • Women's Coach: Vic Schaefer 
    Note: This information is based on results, including some from March 2026, identifying Sean Miller as the current head coach.
